entities.summary: Elvira Bayakhmetovna Berend is a Kazakhstan-born Luxembourg chess player who holds the FIDE title of Woman Grandmaster (WGM). She is a three-time Luxembourg Chess Championship winner and four-time World Women's Over 50 Chess Championship winner.
